scope: CPU contracts only; all real-video methods NOT_RUN

proposed_model.v4_comparison: not included in primary B0/B1/B2; optional later separately approved

proposed_sampling.frame_policy: streaming PTS-based; frozen shared union; no private extra frames
proposed_sampling.shot_detection: PySceneDetect planned, max4 scenes; keep manifest of dropped scenes; never equate absence with negative
proposed_sampling.clustering: omitted v1; uniformly spread PTS representatives from shared budget

proposed_parser.raw_graph_choice: first structurally valid sample per fixed evidence group, ordered seed; deterministic assembly, never checker-selected
proposed_parser.frequency_matching: exact canonical signature incl bound intervals and explicit entity IDs after deterministic alignment; no fuzzy fallback
proposed_parser.fact_cap_policy: reject graph if >64; never truncate dependency closure

proposed_b0.prompt: video + locked fixed template question + minimal response format; differs from official benchmark reasoning prompt
